author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Going back to work after 2 weeks of vacation, my inbox has hundreds of unreal emails.  I tried to ask the AI to help me deal with the pile.  

Long story short, at the end I still have to deal with the emails the old fashion way. AI can help me filter out unless emails, but it can't tell what is truly important that I absolutely have to reply on the first day.
